BiblicalUsage: Erḗmōsis is desolation — the laying waste itself, the ruined state after the destroying. Jesus warns of the abomination of desolation standing in the holy place, and of Jerusalem's desolation drawing near. It is the word for what is left when judgment has done its work.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe erḗmōsis is a word to heed, not to argue over: Jesus warns, and the warning is meant to move feet. I hold that the sign is given so that God's people will flee, not so that scholars will debate.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
